status: INVENTORY ONLY - no signal is scored, weighted, or shipped as a feature in Phase 0
completeness: NECESSARILY INCOMPLETE. Category-first per scout doctrine: this list supplements a category rule and is never the rule itself.

signals.name: Form ADV Item 4 (Successions)
signals.mechanism: Item 4 asks whether the filer is succeeding to the business of a registered adviser. It is the single most direct declared succession event on the form.
signals.surface: NOT IN BULK. Measured 0 occurrences across all 23,794 firm records in IA_FIRM_SEC_Feed_08_21_2026. Available only in the per-firm ADV PDF (reports.adviserinfo.sec.gov/reports/ADV/<crd>/PDF/<crd>.pdf).
signals.cost_if_pursued: ~929 KB and one request per firm; ~22 GB and 23,794 requests for full coverage.
signals.validation: Sample N firms known to have transacted (from public M&A press) and confirm Item 4 fires; measure false-negative rate against that set.

signals.name: Schedule A/B direct and indirect owner changes
signals.mechanism: Ownership stake changes precede and accompany sale; Schedule A lists direct owners, Schedule B indirect.
signals.surface: NOT IN BULK. No Schedule A/B element anywhere in the corpus. Per-firm PDF only (confirmed present in sampled PDF).
signals.validation: Same as S1; additionally diff two per-firm PDFs across an interval and confirm the diff is machine-extractable.

signals.name: Employee headcount contraction (Item 5A TtlEmp, Item 5B)
signals.mechanism: A shrinking advisory headcount can precede wind-down or sale; Item 5B decomposes advisory-function staff.
signals.surface: IN BULK. Item5A@TtlEmp present on 17,132 of 23,794 firms (72.0%). Median 8, p90 63, max 41,879.
signals.validation: Requires longitudinal snapshots. Measure the base rate of YoY headcount decline across the whole population BEFORE treating decline as signal - most decline will be noise. Pre-register the decline threshold against the observed distribution [E8].
signals.hazard: Coverage gap is structural: ERAs (6,661 firms) do not complete the full item set. A missing field must not score as calm [scout risk.py _ABSENCE_REASONS lesson].

signals.name: Regulatory AUM and account-count trajectory (Item 5F)
signals.mechanism: Sustained AUM/account decline is a distress or wind-down proxy; sharp rise can indicate an acquisition already completed.
signals.surface: IN BULK. Item5F@Q5F2C present on 16,783 firms. Median $439,211,752; p90 $7,084,560,665.
signals.validation: Longitudinal. AUM moves with markets - any threshold must be market-adjusted or it will fire on every drawdown. Validate against a market-return control before use.
signals.hazard: E5 unit-scale: values are raw USD integers. Confirm per-filer, do not assume.

signals.name: Principal age proxy from registration-year arithmetic
signals.mechanism: Time since first registration proxies career stage; late-career principals are likelier to seek succession.
signals.surface: Individual feed carries exam dates (Exm@exmDt) and registration begin dates (CrntRgstn@regBeginDt, PrevRgstn). Firm feed carries no principal-level dates.
signals.validation: This is INFERENCE, not fact, and must be encoded as claim-not-fact. It cannot be validated against ground truth because date of birth is not public. Treat as an unfalsifiable prior and weight accordingly - or do not use it.
signals.verdict: INFERENCE ONLY - encode as claim, never as fact
signals.blocked_by: I-3 (person-level). Also gated on the unresolved firm-facing wall.

signals.name: Registration status transitions
signals.mechanism: A move out of APPROVED, or an ERA changing scope, marks a lifecycle event that often accompanies a sale or wind-down.
signals.surface: IN BULK. Rgstn@FirmType/@St/@Dt. Observed distribution: Registered/APPROVED 16,900; ERA/ACTIVE 6,661; Registered/APPROVED-120 233.
signals.validation: Longitudinal diff. APPROVED-120 (233 firms) is a small, well-defined cohort worth a manual read to learn what the state actually means before any rule keys on it.

signals.name: Filing-cadence anomaly
signals.mechanism: Off-cycle amendments (outside the annual updating amendment window) can indicate a material change such as ownership or control.
signals.surface: IN BULK but WEAK. Filing@Dt is the date of the MOST RECENT filing only - the feed is a snapshot, not an event stream. 23,030 of 23,794 firms carry a 2026 filing date; 534 distinct dates observed.
signals.validation: Requires FDU to accumulate its own daily snapshots. The publisher retains only an 8-day rolling window (measured), so at most 8 days of history can be bootstrapped.
signals.verdict: AVAILABLE ONLY IF FDU SNAPSHOTS FROM DAY ONE
signals.hazard: The order treats 'filing-cadence anomalies' as directly observable. It is not - the observable is a single last-filing date per snapshot.

signals.name: State succession-plan filing requirements
signals.mechanism: Some states require IAs to maintain or file a business-continuity/succession plan; the filing itself would be a surface.
signals.surface: NOT ESTABLISHED THIS SESSION. FL's own datamart is reCAPTCHA-gated and was skipped. No state was found publishing succession-plan filings as retrievable data.
signals.validation: Desk-read NASAA model rule adoption state by state, then test whether adopting states publish the filings or merely require them to be maintained. The likely answer is 'maintained, not filed' - which would make this signal unobservable rather than merely hard.

signals.name: Practice M&A marketplace public listings
signals.mechanism: A firm listed for sale has already declared intent.
signals.surface: See T3. Listings on FP Transitions and RIA Match are gated behind account creation.
signals.validation: n/a - blocked at access, not at extraction.
signals.verdict: BLOCKED BY I-1/I-5 (account creation is not available to FDU)
